advance.not_paid_by_day: This worker has no daily pay.
advance.own: You can't record or cross out your own advance.

pay.day_approved: The pay of this day is closed, so it can't change any more.

pay_run.already_approved: This month's pay is already approved.
pay_run.later_month_approved: A later month is already approved, so this one is closed.
pay_run.month_not_over: This month isn't over. It is approved once it is.
pay_run.nobody: Nobody is paid in this month.
pay_run.earlier_month_open: An earlier month isn't approved yet. Approve that one first.
pay_run.days_waiting: Some days still wait for a decision. Decide them first.
pay_run.days_without_rate: Some days have no daily pay. Set the daily pay first.
pay_run.totals_moved: The totals have changed since you read them. Read them again, then approve.

payslip.not_left: This worker still works here. Their pay is approved with everyone's once the month is over.
payslip.already_approved: This worker's pay is already approved.
payslip.nothing: This worker has no pay in this month.
payslip.own: You can't approve your own pay alone.
payslip.still_clocked_in: This worker hasn't tapped Toka yet today.

payment.own: You can't mark your own pay paid, or cross it out.
payment.nothing_to_pay: This payslip pays 0, so there is nothing to hand over.
payment.already_paid: This worker is already paid this pay.
payment.signature_missing: The worker must draw their signature first.
payment.reference_invalid: A transaction number has only letters and digits.
payment.reference_used: This transaction number is already used for another payment.

flag.own_flag: This flag names you, so someone else closes it.

attachment.not_found: The server has no such photo.
attachment.too_big: This photo is too big: a photo can be at most 1 MB.
attachment.not_an_image: This file isn't a photo. Only JPEG and WebP photos are kept.
attachment.file_differs: This photo isn't the one its record names. It may have been damaged on the way.
attachment.file_waiting: This photo hasn't reached the server yet. It comes once the laptop is online.
attachment.length_required: The photo was sent without its size. It has to be sent again.
attachment.cut_short: The whole photo didn't arrive. Try again.

errors.password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose another.
errors.password_entirely_numeric: A password can't be only numbers.
errors.password_too_similar: This password is too close to the person's name or phone.

pairing.code_invalid: This code isn't written right. Type it as the device shows it.
pairing.code_unknown: No device is waiting with this code.
pairing.code_expired: This code has expired. Ask the device for a new one.

setting.date_past: A new value can't start before today.
setting.out_of_order: This time breaks the day's order: each attendance time must be after the one above it and before the one below it, from the day you chose, including changes already set for later days.
setting.side_not_allowed: This rule has one value for the whole shop, not for one side.
setting.side_required: Choose a side: this rule is set for each side on its own.
setting.value_invalid: This value doesn't fit this rule.

side.code_invalid: A side's letter is one capital letter, like D.
side.code_taken: Another side of this shop already has this letter.
side.sale_flow_unknown: This way of selling isn't known.

errorFallback.noConnection: Couldn't reach the server. Check the internet, then try again.
errorFallback.waitAWhile: Too many tries. Wait a little, then try again.
